primitives.note: Cunning Sweep/Sundering Slam, Repudiation's smash, Lacerate's spin, and Public Execution's damage each land on a short fixed delay after cast (lockout end / cast time end), then go on cooldown.
Medarda Maxim stacks arm Ambessa's next basic attack to deal bonus physical on-hit damage, gain range/attack speed, and restore energy; consumed on-hit.
Medarda Maxim: casting any ability grants a stack (up to 3) lasting 4s, refreshing on subsequent casts.
Each empowered basic attack deals extra physical damage (level-scaled + 25% bonus AD) and grants 50% bonus attack speed for that swing.

Q: Cunning Sweep opens a 4s window to cast the separately-timed Sundering Slam. E: Lacerate spins once on cast and a second time (same damage, no extra cost) if Drakehound's Step dash is triggered afterward.

Q's slash/slam doubles damage against the outer-edge (Q1) or first-hit (Q2) target vs. other hits; W's smash deals 50% more damage only if its on-cast shield mitigated champion/large-monster/turret damage before the smash lands.
Whether the single stationary dummy counts as being struck at Cunning Sweep's outer cone edge / as Sundering Slam's first hit must be assumed, since both determine which of two damage values applies.
Q, W, and E each cost 70 energy; no energy regen rate is given in the sources, so sustaining a full-ability rotation across 15s requires an assumption.

W grants a 1.5s self-shield on cast; R's passive heals Ambessa for a % of post-mitigation damage she deals. Neither changes the dummy's health/damage-taken, and R's heal specifically triggers off Ambessa's own outgoing damage rather than incoming damage, so it does not aid her in a survival fight either.
Public Execution has a 0.7s cast time during which Ambessa is locked out (unable to act) before the strike/blink resolves.

needsBespoke.why: Every mechanic (Medarda Maxim's stacking empowered attacks, Q's two-part Cunning Sweep/Sundering Slam combo with edge/first-hit doubling, E's dash-triggered free second spin, W's conditional shield-based damage amp, R's channelled single-target burst with self-heal/armor pen) maps onto existing closed-list primitives; nothing requires logic the list cannot express.

unsettled.question: Is Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam's doubled-damage hit (outer edge / first target) a discrete either/or value, or a continuous interpolation across the cone/line using the unresolved bin calculation, and against a single stationary dummy which value actually applies?
options: Binary: the dummy either counts fully as the 'outer edge'/'first hit' target (doubled value) or fully as an inner/non-first hit (halved value), matching the wiki's discrete description
Continuous: damage interpolates between the Min_Ratio (0.5x) and full value based on exact hit position via the unresolved {f3cbe7b2} calculation, which is not resolved in the sheet
quotes: The damage is {{ccs|doubled|physical}} against enemies hit by the outer edge.

unsettled.question: Does the stationary target dummy resist Public Execution's suppression (as CC-immune training dummies typically do), which per the wiki notes would prevent the attach, damage, and stun from ever applying even though Ambessa still blinks to it?
options: Dummy is treated as a normal enemy champion (not CC-immune), so R's suppression, damage, and stun apply normally
Dummy is CC-immune, so Ambessa blinks to it but the suppression/attach fails and R's damage never lands
quotes: If the target resists the suppression by being {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}, {{tip|displacement immune}}, or having a {{tip|spell shield}}, '''Ambessa''' will not attach them to herself.
She will be unable to apply the damage and stun in this case since the suppression was not applied in the first place.

unsettled.question: What energy regeneration rate should be assumed for sustaining Q/W/E (70 energy each) across the 15s damage fight, since neither source states Ambessa's energy regen?
options: Assume base champion energy regen is high enough to allow near-continuous casting of all three basic abilities on cooldown
Energy is a genuine bottleneck, forcing the rotation to skip some casts or attacks to stay within budget

proposal: Ensure a Medarda Maxim stack is available at the start (e.g. from a pre-fight ability cast) so the opening auto-attack can be empowered.
Open with Public Execution (R) for its large upfront burst and to apply its passive armor penetration for the rest of the fight (only usable once given its 100-130s cooldown).
Immediately cast Cunning Sweep (Q1), then within the 4s window follow up with Sundering Slam (Q2), positioning both hits for their doubled-damage (outer edge / first-hit) value against the dummy.
Cast Repudiation (W) for its base smash damage (its 50% conditional bonus will not trigger since the stationary dummy never deals mitigated damage to the shield).
Cast Lacerate (E) and buffer Drakehound's Step immediately after so the dash triggers a second free spin, doubling E's effective damage per use.
Weave in empowered basic attacks whenever a Medarda Maxim stack is available (generated after each ability's lockout), prioritizing them over unempowered swings.

Repeat Q, W, E on cooldown for the remainder of the 15s, continuing to buffer Drakehound's Step after each lockout to keep gaining the E double-spin and stay in melee/attack range without losing tempo.
Fill any remaining time between ability cooldowns with plain basic attacks.
questions: Should R be cast first to front-load burst and armor pen, or held until after Q's combo to maximize total damage output over the 15s window?
Does buffering Drakehound's Step after every ability cost any effective time/tempo in a dummy fight, or is it free as the wiki implies?
Is the target dummy guaranteed to be hit by Sundering Slam as the 'first enemy' (since it's the only target), or could engine mechanics still classify a single target as a non-first hit?
Should the rotation assume energy is unconstrained, or does a realistic energy regen value force cutting attacks/casts, changing optimal ability ordering?
